learning_goals: Buying tickets for a historic site
Understanding rules and signs (e.g., 'no climbing', 'restricted areas')
Asking about the history and significance of the site
Finding specific locations within the site (e.g., towers, museums, toilets)
Dealing with temporary closures or restoration work
required_interactions: Asking for ticket prices (full vs reduced)
Asking if a specific area is accessible
Asking for information about a historical period
common_problems: No access for disabled or injured persons (stairs)
